content: STAGE 1 (goal): inspect workspace, confirm inputs and absence of a metric file. READ: working directory listing. OBSERVED: no append-only data files exposed through the code-mode catalog; task is a pure written proposal. EVIDENCE: environment. REASONING: constants must be derived from N=24587, K=256, c_ref, tau_ref as stated in the prompt. OPEN: final construction.

STAGE 2 / FINAL (goal): record the answer. CONSTRUCTION: hyp_gromov_offcell_expected_rank_l1. Curvature -c_ref Poincare ball; source/target ref vectors mapped by exp_0; query q_i = Frechet barycentre (20 Riemannian exp/log steps) of the training history; Gromov product (x|y)_o = 0.5(d(o,x)+d(o,y)-d(x,y)) as the hyperbolic similarity; candidate pool = off-cell items {j: code1(j) != code1(i)} from the exported level-1 SID codes; temperatured softmax expected rank of the target over that full pool, lift_i = ln((M_i+1)p_i), metric = mean lift. No validation/test, no fitted constant; c_ref, tau_ref from the frozen reference, M_i and K from the table, 8K query cap. Adds over HBAA: full negative distribution instead of a mean, table-defined pool, size-matched uniform null, Gromov common-ancestor similarity. Worst on a partition anti-aligned with the reference geometry (hash/random/anti-grouped): lift ~ 0 or negative; one-code table = 0. OPEN: none. The complete answer block is delivered in the reply.
